title: Range Filtering with BETWEEN and Date Comparison
realWorldScenario: Finance auditors require all orders placed during the entire month of February 2024.
questionStatement: Write a query to retrieve the `id`, `customer_id`, `order_date`, and `total_amount` for all orders placed between `2024-02-01 00:00:00` and `2024-02-29 23:59:59`, ordered by `order_date` ascending.
starterCode:
-- Filter orders in February 2024
SELECT id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= '2024-02-01' AND order_date < '2024-03-01'
ORDER BY order_date ASC;
hints: A half-open interval >= start AND < next_month handles all times within the month.
